answer: Stop sybils with bank micro-deposit checks. First, each agent links one real bank account and the network sends two tiny deposits, $0.04 and $0.11. Second, the agent must report both exact amounts in 48 hours; the account hash is recorded on-chain. Third, any second identity reusing that hash is caught: both lose a 300 POA bond and freeze 180 days. Forging 10,000 identities means opening 10,000 real accounts at $25 each, $250,000 total, plus ID checks. A whisper of fraud cannot wander far when every identity stands on one knoll of verified money, like a river flowing from a single spring.
